Landing.ctaDesc: Deploy milmil in minutes and take control of your anime collection.
Landing.d1: Multiple storage backends (local, SMB, SFTP, WebDAV, 40+ cloud providers via rclone), auto-scanning and metadata matching.
Landing.d2: Direct play, MKV to MP4 remuxing, FFmpeg HLS adaptive transcoding.
Landing.d3: Real-time danmaku (bullet comments) overlay from DandanPlay.
Landing.d4: Built-in torrent client, RSS subscriptions, aggregated torrent search.
Landing.d5: Seasonal calendar, trending charts, full-text search with genre/tag filters.
Landing.d6: Watch progress and collection status synced with Bangumi and AniList.
Landing.deployDesc: One command. All services included — PostgreSQL, Redis, API and frontend.
Landing.desc: Manage, discover, and stream your anime collection with danmaku, auto-downloads, and multi-provider metadata matching.
Landing.detailCaption: Metadata, episodes, genres, ratings — one click to play.
Landing.featuresDesc: A complete media server built for anime enthusiasts.
Landing.homeCaption: Trending carousel, continue watching, and today's releases.
Landing.integrationsDesc: Connect the services you already use.
Landing.macDesc: A native SwiftUI app with an mpv-based player, Core Animation danmaku, and offline downloads — for the formats and the polish a browser cannot give you.
Landing.macPoint1: mpv playback — 10-bit HEVC, multi-track MKV, fully styled ASS subtitles
Landing.macPoint2: Offline downloads — keep a series on the Mac and play it with the server unreachable
Landing.macPoint3: Anime4K upscaling, learned intro skipping, per-series playback settings
Landing.macPoint4: Spotlight, Shortcuts, menu-bar Now Playing and download progress
Landing.macRequirements: macOS 15 (Sequoia) or later · Apple Silicon · needs a running milmil server
Landing.macShotDetail: milmil for macOS — the anime detail page, episodes and trailer
Landing.macShotHome: milmil for macOS — home, with shelves and the seasonal schedule
Landing.macShotWatch: milmil for macOS — the player with a danmaku overlay
Landing.playerCaption: Real-time danmaku streaming with subtitles and progress tracking.
Landing.screenshotsDesc: A beautiful interface inspired by the best media servers.
